title: Deposit cap boundary is not enforced
summary: A bounded parameter corpus reaches a one-step state where the declared maximum deposit of 100 is exceeded by fund(101).
impact: A contract whose implementation omits an intended deposit cap can accept states outside its declared business rules. The local fixture demonstrates how deterministic boundary-value exploration can surface that mismatch.
recommendation: Enforce the maximum deposit atomically inside fund() and keep fund(101) as a regression case after the fix.

evidence.authorization: Deliberately vulnerable local fixture owned by this repository; no third-party production target is involved.
evidence.notes: The corpus checks values below, at, and immediately above the declared boundary: 1, 100, and 101.
